prerequisites: Fundamentals of geometric modeling and CAD systems.
Basic knowledge about numerically controlled machine tools.

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge about existing solutions supporting structural design and technology.
Ordered knowledge of technological design in CAM systems.
Knowledge regarding the selection, integration and implementation of CAD/CAM systems in enterprises.
Student should be able to analyze parts taking into account that will be manufactured on CNC machine tools. Analysis of the structure manufacturability.
Student should be able to prepare geometric data necessary to carry out project work.
Student should be able to prepare a technological process for CNC machine tools using selected CAD/CAM systems.
Ability to work in a team project.
Ability to critically evaluate the results and their impact on the functioning of the company.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to CAD/CAM. A review of available solutions.
Project management in an environment of CAD/CAM system. Relationship between documents. Generating the documentation.
Technological design in CAM systems. The steps and tasks performed.
Technological design in CAM systems. Functions of CAM.
Presentation of the selected environment of CAD/CAM system.
Solid modeling in a CAD system.
Surface modeling in a CAD system.
Preparation of geometric models for processing by milling.
Technological design in the CAM system - milling module. 2.5D machining.
Project management. Processes verification through computer simulation. NC code generation.
Generating tool paths for 3D models where 3 axes control is required.
Technological design in the CAM system - turning module.
Use of the FBM method in the design of technology for machined parts.
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
self study - preparation for laboratory class
assessment_rules: For lectures, the final test evaluates educational effects PEK_W01, PEK_W02, PEK_W03. For laboratory, a task at the last meeting evaluates educational effects PEK_U01, PEK_U02, PEK_U03, PEK_K01, PEK_K02.
